name: logo-reveal
label: D&D Brand Co. logo animation (client upsell)

brief.Goal (one sentence): Give the client's new logo a 3–5 s signature reveal they can use everywhere.
brief.Deliverables: 16:9 reveal (MP4) + transparent overlay (WebM alpha + ProRes 4444) + still
brief.Where it will be used: Video intros and outros, social, presentations
brief.Look & feel references: Ben Marriott: shape morphs, ink and paper; or clean geometric build

panels.title: Build
panels.action: The mark's shapes draw on or morph in (evolvePath / shape morph).

panels.title: Resolve
panels.action: Logo locks into place; wordmark slides in.

panels.title: Hold
panels.action: Hold with tagline; clean last frame for a still.

hardRules: Use the client's vector logo (SVG); vectorise a raster logo with the Adobe connector's image_vectorize if needed.
Brand colours exactly as the brand guide.
Last frame equals the static logo (usable as a still).
visualNotes: Recipe: illustrated-type (shape morphs with @remotion/paths) or a clean geometric build.
qaChecklist: Alpha exports composite cleanly over black and white.
